name: real-ladder-amrap-run-after-each-set-20260913
description: REAL saved doc (13 Sep 2026), metcon part only, with the run repaired to the board's 200m. A 16-min ascending ladder AMRAP (4-8-12-16-20…) with a fixed '200m run after each set'; 5 rungs climbed. The run line must state its per-round distance, WHERE it sits ('every round'), and its total counted from the rungs climbed — 5 × 200m. Before the fix the line read '200M EVERY ROUND' with no total, and an edit rewrote the run as '1000M EVERY ROUND'.
